decision: Selected the planar centroid of the union of the three contiguous Bell County tax parcels that the TxGIO StratMap land-parcel layer lists as owned by ROWAN TEMPLE LLC on Bob White Road (Bell Appraisal District, tax year 2026; M. Moreno survey A0014BC), which contain the street frontage of 1855 Bob White Road where TDLR registered Rowan Digital Infrastructure's AUS02 (Building 2) data-center project, as the campus locator replacing the imported Temple city point.
layer: TxGIO 'stratmap_land_parcels_48_most_recent' MapServer identify (layer 0), envelope -97.95,30.75,-97.05,31.32 with layerDefs UPPER(OWNER_NAME) LIKE '%ROWAN TEMPLE%', returnGeometry true

facts.centroid_method: shapely centroid of the union in a local transverse Mercator (WGS84) at the union centroid, transformed back; the planar WGS84 centroid differs by 0.01 m
facts.tdlr_project_address: 1855 Bob White Road, Temple, TX 76501 (TABS2026026121, AUS02 (Building 2)); its house number lies between the 1707 and 2351 Bob White situs numbers of the selected parcels; no official address point was used

exclusions: Only parcels owned by the named LLC are used; about 145 acres of the roughly 700-acre campus Rowan describes are not in parcels under that name, so the locator describes the Rowan Temple LLC holding. No geocoder, map viewport or city centre is used; contact and accessibility-specialist names in the TDLR record are not reproduced.
